    Profile

    Shekinah is a "Killer Princess" from the Church of Ragnarok, guided to this world from the continent of Ragna. She shares her name with her Killium weapon. She always maintains a dignified appearance and a strict manner, which gives her a strange impactful presence. She's very reliable, but utterly unforgiving of those who break the rules.

    Origin: Ragna
    Gender: Female
    Height: 161cm
    Weight: 52kg
    Birthday: Feb 7
    Blood Type: Type A
    Zodiac: Aquarius
    Likes: Shiny and sparkling things
    Hobbies: Flashy fashion
    Illust: gg2 Art Team
    CV: 名塚佳織
